faq.label: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.heading: Answers before you join
faq.description: If you're wondering how ELEVN works, start here. Short answers now, full product very soon.
faq.a1: ELEVN will be the ultimate marketplace connecting creators with top global brands. Coming soon, it will be your main hub to get direct access to paid campaigns, AI optimization tools, and exclusive monetization programs to scale your business.
faq.q2: How many followers do I need to join ELEVN?
faq.a2: You need at least 1,000 followers on one of your accounts (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.). Beyond that, we care about your talent and the quality of your content—any creator who meets that baseline can join, scale, and unlock real opportunities.
faq.q3: Is it free to join ELEVN?
faq.a3: Yes. Creating your profile and accessing opportunities is 100% free.
faq.q4: What kind of brands will I work with?
faq.a4: You'll get access to a premium portfolio. This includes global tech partners as well as massive consumer brands.
faq.q5: How does ELEVN match me with campaigns?
faq.a5: Campaigns are matched based on your niche, content style, target audience, and brand fit—not just your follower count. The goal is to pair you with briefs where you can genuinely perform and build long-term relationships.
faq.q6: Do I keep ownership of my content?
faq.a6: Yes. Unless a specific brief states otherwise, you keep ownership of your content and grant brands usage rights only for the agreed period and channels. ELEVN is built to protect creators and make terms crystal clear.
faq.q7: Which platforms does ELEVN focus on?
faq.a7: ELEVN is optimized for short-form and social video first: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and UGC-style content for paid media. Over time, we'll expand into more formats and platforms where creators can monetize.
